tasks.name: סכום במקומות הזוגיים
tasks.note: Positional aggregate: sum of the elements at indices 0,2,4,... reduced mod 16 (empty gives 0).

tasks.name: מספר העליות
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++) if(l[i]>l[i-1]) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Counts ascents: neighbouring pairs where the later element is larger (fewer than 2 elements gives 0).

tasks.name: מספר פסגות
tasks.src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if(l[i]>l[i-1]&&l[i]>l[i+1]) c++; return c; }
tasks.note: Counts interior local maxima, each compared with both neighbours; the ends never count.

tasks.name: שרשרת ערכים עוקבים
tasks.src: l=>{ let best=0; for(const x of l){ if(l.includes(x-1)) continue; let k=1; while(l.includes(x+k)) k++; if(k>best) best=k; } return best; }
tasks.note: Longest chain of consecutive values x,x+1,...,x+k-1 all present in the list, regardless of position (empty gives 0).

tasks.name: XOR של כולם
tasks.note: Bitwise XOR fold over the whole list, 0 for the empty list.

tasks.name: AND של כולם
tasks.note: Bitwise AND fold over the whole list with identity 15, so the empty list gives 15.

tasks.name: סכום שני הגדולים
tasks.note: Top-two sum mod 16 (always above 15 internally when two elements exist); one element gives itself, empty gives 0.

tasks.name: שאריות שונות ב-4
tasks.note: Counts how many distinct remainders mod 4 occur in the list (0..4).

tasks.name: כמה מעל הממוצע
tasks.note: Scores above average: compares each element with the mean via x*n > sum, a total far above 15 (empty gives 0).

tasks.name: הקפיצה הגדולה
tasks.src: l=>{ let m=0; for(let i=1;i<l.length;i++) m=Math.max(m,Math.abs(l[i]-l[i-1])); return m; }
tasks.note: Largest absolute difference between neighbouring elements (biggest price swing); fewer than 2 elements gives 0.

tasks.name: הפרש בין החצאים
tasks.src: l=>{ const h=l.length>>1; let a=0,b=0; for(let i=0;i<h;i++){ a+=l[i]; b+=l[l.length-1-i]; } return Math.min(15,Math.abs(a-b)); }
tasks.note: Absolute difference between the sums of the first and second halves (middle of an odd list ignored), sums up to 54 internally, capped at 15.

tasks.name: ארגזים של 10
tasks.note: Packing: total (up to 92) divided by a capacity of 10, rounded up, i.e. boxes needed (empty gives 0).
